name: crossslice
description: Commit and code context for C: def-use slices, callees, callers and macros, in an interactive call-graph explorer.

commands.title: Show Symbol Under Cursor in Explorer

markdownEnumDescriptions: Use the local `crossslice` command when it is installed, otherwise Docker.
Run the `crossslice` command installed on this machine (`uv tool install`).
Run the CrossSlice Docker image with the workspace folder mounted; nothing else needs to be installed.
crossslice.backend.description: How the analysis backend is started.

crossslice.localCommand.markdownDescription: Command for the local backend, e.g. `crossslice` or `uv run --project /path/to/crossslice crossslice`.

crossslice.gumtreePath.markdownDescription: Local backend: path to GumTree's `bin/gumtree`. Empty: `GUMTREE_PATH`, `gumtree` on PATH, or a release unpacked under `/opt/gumtree`, `~/gumtree` or similar is found automatically.

crossslice.env.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the backend process, e.g. `{"PATH": "/opt/global/bin:${env:PATH}"}`.

crossslice.dockerCommand.markdownDescription: Container CLI: `docker` or `podman`. Empty: `docker` if available, else `podman`.

crossslice.dockerImage.markdownDescription: Image to run, e.g. `crossslice` (built locally with `docker build -t crossslice .`) or `ghcr.io/<org>/crossslice:0.1.0`.

crossslice.dockerCacheVolume.description: Named volume that keeps indexes and graph stores between runs.

crossslice.dockerExtraArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments for `docker run`, e.g. `["--security-opt", "label=disable"]` on SELinux hosts.

crossslice.codeLens.description: Show a CrossSlice CodeLens above every C function definition while the backend runs.

scripts.package: npm run check && npm run build && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --no-dependencies
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check && npm run build
